fix.notes: The fix is purely additive — a new function alongside the existing one, with a one-line call-site change. The matchup page only needs name and id for the dropdown, so no data is lost. The issue comment also mentions the dropdown should become a typeahead; that's a separate UI task and was not touched here.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `/matchups/` page called `load_people(where='p.mtgo_username IS NOT NULL')` to build the people dropdown. That function does a `LEFT JOIN` on `deck` and `deck_cache`, then aggregates wins/losses/draws/etc. — all of which is unnecessary just to render a list of `(id, name)` pairs for the UI.

## What changed

- **`decksite/data/person.py`**: Added `load_people_statless(where='TRUE') -> list[Person]` — a lean query that selects only `p.id`, `person_query() AS name`, and `p.mtgo_username` from `person AS p` with no deck joins and no aggregation.
- **`decksite/controllers/metagame.py` line 158**: Replaced `ps.load_people(where='p.mtgo_username IS NOT NULL')` with `ps.load_people_statless(where='p.mtgo_username IS NOT NULL')`. Removed the unused tuple-unpack since the new function returns a plain list.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — all checks passed.
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected (19 s). Full suite ran against a live MariaDB instance in the cloud workspace.

Fixes #11298
fix.pr_title: Add load_people_statless to speed up /matchups/ people dropdown (#11298)

evidence.detail: matchups() calls ps.load_people(where='p.mtgo_username IS NOT NULL') — the full aggregating query — just to build a people dropdown
load_people() runs a query with COUNT/SUM aggregations over deck and deck_cache including wins, losses, tournament_wins etc. — identical in structure to the slow 1.1s query reported in the issue
load_person_statless() exists and uses a simpler query (no joins to deck/deck_cache), but only returns one Person — a list variant does not exist
the view only reads p.mtgo_username and p.id from each Person for the people dropdown — no stats fields are used

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/person.py, add a load_people_statless(where='TRUE') function that selects only p.id, person_query() AS name, and p.mtgo_username from person WHERE {where} (no deck/deck_cache joins, no aggregation). In decksite/controllers/metagame.py:158, replace load_people(where='p.mtgo_username IS NOT NULL') with load_people_statless(where='p.mtgo_username IS NOT NULL'). Total change ~20 lines.
triage.notes: This issue and #11305 are related — #11305's typeahead proposal would also eliminate the bulk person load, but #11298 can be fixed independently without UI changes.
